name: Ratio audit evidence pack
kind_note: Kind-aware cites, not a chrome fork. Closes, journal prefix, and config digests apply to every kind. NAV strikes and breaks stay unset on Personal / Project / Operating (fund-ops chrome). UNSPECIFIED is the proto default, not a fifth kind.

period_close.note: ListPeriodCloses / GetPeriodClose already expose closed-through, journal prefix, journal digest, and config digest. This app copies those cites. It does not replace ratio close. An empty digest is unset, not history-intact.

nav_strikes.note: NavStrike already pins journal_position, journal_digest, config_digest, and net_asset_value. WashRestatement cites the strike and does not rewrite it. A missing strike is unset, not NAV 0.00. Empty digest is unset, not reproduced.

breaks.note: Break and BreakExplanation are already on the book. A missing BreakReport is unset — not a silent reconciled-empty file. A cited report with no lines is cited-empty (the period reconciled). breaks:explain reads a person-attributed explanation; this app does not invent one.

blob_store.note: No kernel blob store. The pack is a ZIP of cites, assembled here. It does not mutate the journal and it does not replace period close.

lp_portal.note: No LP portal, no e-sign, no second journal. Those stay Connect leftovers on #161 / #150. This file does not start them.

grant_path.note: In-process /v1 accepts Connect catalog scopes after membership. API Gateway JWT verifies Connect tokens on ConnectApiUrl. leftover #22: live provider OAuth, RATIO_DEMO_OPEN, unused Cognito. Write-route actor binding landed (#151). This file leaves #150 and #185 open. It does not reopen #151.
